definitions.explanation: A machine used to dry laundry after washing.
Equipment used to remove moisture from various materials.

notes:
{乾燥機|かんそうき} is a compound noun: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (drying) + ⟦{機|き}→機：09843_ki⟧ (machine).

TYPES:
- ⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧{乾燥機|かんそうき} (clothes dryer)
- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧{乾燥機|かんそうき} (dish dryer)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧{乾燥機|かんそうき} (futon dryer)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乾燥機|かんそうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to put in the dryer)
- {乾燥機|かんそうき}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦{可|か}→可：noentry⟧/⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧ (dryer-safe / not dryer-safe)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many people prefer air-drying laundry outdoors. Dryers are less common in homes compared to Western countries due to humidity concerns and electricity costs. ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧{乾燥機|かんそうき} (bathroom dryer) is common in apartments.
